answer: Capacity-bounded vouching resists sybils: trust reaches an identity only along a non-kin path back to a seeded honest core, and each honest attester holds a fixed vouch budget it cannot exceed. A sybil region can mint any number of internal quartz-bright edges, yet none create trust; the region's admitted weight is capped by the honest budget spent crossing its boundary, like a river throttled at its delta. Ten thousand fakes draw no more core trust than the handful of honest edges actually willing to reach across to them.
